Crr-3110-2025 (O&M) - 1-
 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana
At Chandigarh.

109 Crr-3110-2025 (O&M)
 Date of Decision: 05.12.2025
Rohit Dhir ...Petitioner.
 Versus
State of Punjab and others ....Respondents.

* * *
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Sukhvinder Kaur
 ----

Present: Dr. Sumati Jund, Advocate and
 Mr. Rahul Saini, Advocate for the petitioner.
(through Video conferencing)

** ** 
Sukhvinder Kaur, J.

By way of present revision petition, the petitioner has challenged order dated 31.10.2025 passed by
learned trial Court, vide which the petitioner's application for issuing direction to complainant Rohit
Dhir to produce notice dated 25.10.2018, compromise dated 12.10.2017, notice dated 19.07.2018
receipt/ compromise dated 01.08.2018 receipt dated 12.11.2018, compromise dated 23.10.2017,
compromise dated 07.10.2017, original agreement dated 22.03.2016 and subsequent writings, was
allowed.

2.  The brief facts relevant for the adjudication of the present revision petition are that FIR No.18 dated 10.02.2017, under Sections 420, 406, 120-B, 467, 468 and 471 IPC was got registered at behest of the petitioner/ complainant at Police Station City Balachaur, District S.B.S. Nagar against the accused.
After completion of investigation challan was 1 of 5 CRR-3110-2025 (O&M) - 2- presented before the trial Court on 28.09.2017.
After framing of charges, the prosecution evidence was led.

When the case was at the stage of leading defence version then application dated 31.07.2025 was filed by the accused before the trial Court for seeking issuance of directions to the present petitioner/ complainant to produce notice dated 25.10.2018, compromise dated 12.10.2017,
notice dated 19.07.2018 receipt/ compromise dated 01.08.2018, receipt dated 12.11.2018,
compromise dated 23.10.2017, compromise dated 07.10.2017, original agreement dated 22.03.2016 and subsequent writings thereof, which was allowed.
Hence the petitioner has knocked the doors of this Court by way of filing the present revision petition.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the the impugned order dated 31.10.2025 is illegal, arbitrary and suffers from patent error, having directed the complainant to produce original documents when the original documents, had earlier been returned by the Court after retaining the photocopies.
The impugned order, directing production of documents at this stage of defence evidence would result in reopening of the prosecution evidence, which had already been concluded.
The application had been moved at a very belated stage when the trial is at the fag end.

Trial Court has also ignored the fact the accused had ample opportunity during cross-examination of PW1 to peruse these documents and he never sought the production of these documents at the appropriate stage and the impugned order is liable to be set aside.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the petitioner and have gone through the relevant record.

6. In the application that was filed by the accused for issuance of 2 of 5 CRR-3110-2025 (O&M) - 3- direction for production of aforesaid documents, it was averred that the complainant had already entered into compromise on 12.10.2017, 23.10.2017, 01.08.2018, 12.11.2018 and 07.10.2017 and also gave undertaking that nothing was due against the applicant/ accused, he would suffer statement in favour of the applicant at the time of appearing before the Court.
Complainant was supported by his Advocates Sh. Varun Khanna and Sh. Vikas Khanna.
Some of the amount was also got deposited by cheque by complainant in their accounts.
All the compromises were duly signed by the complainant and aforesaid Advocates as witnesses.
The complainant stated that they were his cousins and these advocates kept on regularly appearing in the entire proceedings of the case jointly with the complainant.

It was submitted that agreement was not in existence as the same had already been cancelled/ rescinded with the consent of the complainant and his aforesaid Advocates and writing to this effect had been made on the original agreement to sell itself.

The complainant intentionally did not produce on record original agreement to sell only to conceal the said writing, which was duly signed by him, he cleverly got removed the same from the Court file.
It was submitted that the said original agreement was forged by the complainant and only photocopy of said writing had been produced before the Court.

The applicant in the defence evidence intends to prove forgery, fraud played by the complainant while getting report from the expert regarding cutting of said paper and for the said purpose the original agreement was required to be placed on record.

7. In the reply filed by respondent/ complainant, this application was opposed having been filed at a very belated stage when the prosecution 3 of 5 CRR-3110-2025 (O&M) - 4- evidence had already been concluded and when the present case was primarily based on the documentary evidence.
It was also alleged that the original agreement was already part of judicial file and same is Ex.P1.

The compromise dated 05.11.2016 is Ex.P4, compromise dated 27.12.2016 is Ex.P5 and no other documents is in the possession of the complainant.
8.

In the complaint filed by the complainant on the basis of which the present FIR has been registered, it has been alleged that in the month of March 2016, on alluring by the accused,
complainant entered into an agreement with the accused and thereafter, accused persons cheated the complainant.
The agreement to sell dated 22.03.2016 was produced in the Court, during testimony of PW1 Rohit Dhir and after retaining copy of the same on record the original was returned to him.

Subsequently on 05.08.2021, complainant Rohit Dhir produced original Rohit Dhir vs State Of Punjab And Others on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5866119/
2 compromise dated 05.11.2016 and the original was again returned to him by retaining on record copy of the same.

sentences.text: 9. It has been alleged by the applicant/ accused that the original documents are required to be brought on record, while leading defence evidence to prove the alleged forgery, fraud played by the complainant while getting report from the expert regarding cutting of said paper from its middle, as the original agreement to sell was having writing upon the agreement itself, that the same had been cancelled/ rescinded with the consent of complainant and his Advocates Varun Khanna and Vikas Khanna.

As original of agreement dated 22.03.2016 Ex.P1 and the compromise dated 05.11.2016 Ex.P4 had been returned to the complainant while retaining its copies on record, the trial Court has rightly directed the complainant to 4 of 5 CRR-3110-2025 (O&M) - 5- produce the original aforesaid documents on record the same being in his possession and as same are required in the defence evidence. Learned trial Court has rightly observed that Ex.P5 is already on record, so it is not required to be produced.

While referring to the reply filed by the complainant, trial Court has further rightly observed that the remaining documents as per version of the complainant are not in his possession, so as such no direction for producing the other remaining documents by the complainant has been given by the trial Court and it has been rightly observed that the complainant is barred from producing the said document at later stage, which as per his version are not in his possession.
10.
Thus, there being no illegality or infirmity in the impugned order no interference therewith is called for while exercising the revisional jurisdiction by this Court.
The present revision petition being bereft of any merits stands dismissed.
11. All pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of accordingly.
(SUKHVINDER KAUR) JUDGE 05.12.2025.
